name: CAS User Ban VBO
description: Adds a Views Bulk Operations user-cancel action with a CAS ban option.
project_description: Submodule of CAS User Ban that integrates the ban option with Views Bulk Operations (VBO). It provides a VBO action plugin, cas_user_ban_vbo_cancel_user_action, that extends VBO's own Cancel User Action and adds a checkbox to ban the selected users' CAS usernames when their accounts are cancelled from a bulk operations view (for example admin/people). Requires the cas_user_ban and views_bulk_operations modules. The maintainers recommend using this action instead of VBO's built-in cancel action when CAS User Ban is in use.
